articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells Trump ‘we’re not going to let [an AI slowdown] happen’
articles.description: Though Elon Musk and Sam Altman have supported Dario Amodei's calls to slow the pace of AI development, Jensen Huang seems to feel differently.

articles.title: Robinhood plans share redemptions, voting rights for stock tokens, after criticism
articles.description: CEO Vlad Tenev said more shareholder features are coming as Robinhood’s offshore stock tokens draw scrutiny over ownership rights.

articles.title: Kraken brings DeFi yield to tokenized stocks and ETFs
articles.description: Kraken’s new xStocks vaults let investors earn yield on tokenized versions of Nvidia and major US stock market ETFs by lending the assets in DeFi markets.

articles.title: OpenAI buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million, report says
articles.description: Glass Imaging was founded by a pair of former Apple engineers who previously led the team that developed Apple's Portrait Mode.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: AI infrastructure company Cornelis raises $205M to chip away at Nvidia’s dominance
articles.description: The company also announced a product called Active Compute Fabric, a network technology that targets the fact that much GPU time is wasted waiting for data to arrive.

articles.title: Trump's $800 million stake into World Liberty Financial's token now has a timeline to becoming sellable
articles.description: Onchain records show that an $800 million crypto stake that matched Donald Trump's holding was moved into a vesting contract, locking any sales until 2028 after a mandatory 10% token burn.

articles.title: Bitcoin tops $79K, oil falls as Trump says Iran war could end
articles.description: Bitcoin’s price rose toward $80,000 after US President Donald Trump hinted that the US-Iran war would end, pushing oil prices lower.

articles.title: White House crypto adviser says Trump gave up 'historic' ethics powers in compromise
articles.description: President Donald Trump's digital assets adviser spoke at a Washington event the day after a new compromise language was released for the Clarity Act.

articles.title: Amazon Prime Video takes on TikTok with short-form news clips
articles.description: Prime Video is adding on-demand local and national news clips as Amazon joins other streamers experimenting with short-form video to capture younger viewers.

articles.title: Banks escalate stablecoin rewards fight as Senate prepares for a Clarity Act vote
articles.description: Eight banking groups on Monday said they want tighter limits on stablecoin rewards, keeping the ongoing banks-versus-crypto dispute alive in Congress.

articles.title: Strive adds 469 Bitcoin to reach 25,000 BTC treasury
articles.description: Strive’s latest Bitcoin purchase was funded entirely through its SATA preferred stock as the company continues its rapid climb among corporate BTC holders.

articles.title: CLARITY Act faces state AGs opposition ahead of key Senate vote

articles.title: Volkswagen’s crazy-efficient EV borrows an idea from Slate
articles.description: Volkswagen's new efficiency-minded halo car is almost twice as efficient as the most efficient production car, the Lucid Air.

articles.title: With iOS 27, I’m actually using Siri again
articles.description: Apple’s long-delayed Siri overhaul is finally here with iOS 27, and it changes how useful the assistant feels day to day.

articles.title: macOS 27: new Siri takes on AI productivity apps
articles.description: The two most noticeable things about macOS 27 Golden Gate are the newly updated Siri AI and the design changes that make windows and icons more consistent.

articles.title: Fashion app Daydream uses Apple Intelligence to help you shop the outfits in your camera roll

articles.title: Microsoft’s new AI ‘code of conduct’ tells models not to hack systems or trick humans
articles.description: The code of conduct lays out general principles that Microsoft AI models should uphold — supporting humans rather than replacing them, for instance, and accelerating human flourishing — as well as specific safety constraints meant to implement those principles.

articles.title: S&P Global backs Kaiko as Series B reaches $110M
articles.description: The investment brings together major financial institutions as Kaiko expands its data infrastructure for tokenized securities and onchain financial markets.

articles.title: A bipartisan coalition of 17 state attorneys generals urge Senate to reject Clarity Act
articles.description: The state AGs said they were concerned the crypto legislation might restrict their ability to bring securities and commodities cases tied to online scams.
